name_input: PATCO EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED; PATCO EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED
note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 26.11.2026. Tooling was largely unavailable during this run: the web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt, Google returned HTTP 429, DuckDuckGo timed out, Zauba Corp and InstaFinancials returned HTTP 403, and Tofler returned 404 for the guessed URL slug. Consequently NO affirmative screening result could be obtained for this entity and every field is null rather than a fabricated 'clear'. What was actually checked: (1) Sanctions - the OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable but is a JavaScript form that returns no results via plain HTTP GET, so no name query could be executed against the SDN/Non-SDN lists; the BIS Entity List page reachable was only the 15 CFR Part 744 regulatory text, not the searchable Supplement No. 4 list. No sanctions match was found, but equally no sanctions clearance was performed - treat sanctions_hit as UNVERIFIED, not negative. (2) Indian court cases - Indian Kanoon was queried directly. A search for the exact phrase "Patco Exports" returned 0 matching judgments. A broader search for "PATCO" returned 374 documents, but on inspection of the first page all hits belong to clearly different legal entities: Patco Chemical Industries (Customs/Excise Tribunal, 1990), Patco Investment & Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd (Madras HC, 2015), Patco Cyramics Private Limited (Karnataka HC, 2014 and 2026), Patco Automobiles Pvt Ltd (Gujarat HC, 2012), and Patco Precision Components Pvt Ltd (Bombay HC, 2025-2026). None of these is Patco Exports Private Limited, so no litigation attributable to this company was identified - but this is an absence of hits, not a confirmed clean record, since lower courts, NCLT, DRT and district-level filings are not covered by Indian Kanoon. (3) Credit rating - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action could be located; null, not public in anything retrieved. (4) Negative news / regulator actions - no search engine was functional, so no news sweep was possible; null means 'not researched', not 'no adverse news'. (5) Russia/CIS supply evidence - no customs, bill-of-lading or trade-data source could be queried; null. Per project rules, none of the above is a rejection ground: sanctions, court cases and criminal matters are never grounds for rejection, and this company is retained in the database. Recommended follow-up before any reliance: re-run the OFAC Sanctions List Search and BIS Supplement No. 4 queries interactively, query the MCA master data for the exact registered name and state, and run a paid trade-data check for Russia/CIS destinations. Legal identity, HS codes and shipment volumes were deliberately not researched per role scope.
